warnings.message: reviews.body is typed text, which this model does not read, so the request is answered without it and it contributes nothing to the prediction. Type a column categorical if its values are labels rather than prose, or leave it out to say so.

2 of the rows sampled as context are the rows being scored, at one moment or another, carrying the value being asked for. Rows that carry the answer to the question being asked are not sent as context, so these do not go into it.
